sources.title: The government’s vision for buses and approach to delivery
sources.facts: Sets the current delivery approach, accountability and accessibility-plan expectations.
sources.guard: National vision does not prove local routes, funding or delivery.

sources.title: Bus enhanced partnerships
sources.facts: Explains enhanced partnership plans, schemes and links to BSIPs and accessibility plans.
sources.guard: An EP process does not prove service improvements or operator performance.

sources.title: Setting up a bus franchising scheme
sources.facts: Explains assessment, consultation and scheme-making under the Bus Services Acts.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove a franchise will be approved or financially sustainable.

sources.title: Local transport plans
sources.facts: Links local transport plans with BSIPs, enhanced partnerships and bus network accessibility plans.
sources.guard: Plan requirements do not prove funded implementation or service outcomes.

sources.title: Bus service improvement plan
sources.facts: Explains how local transport authorities and operators maintain plans to improve services.
sources.guard: A BSIP is not proof of delivery, patronage growth or route permanence.

sources.title: Bus open data policy
sources.facts: Collects policy and technical guidance for timetable, fare and vehicle-location data.
sources.guard: Open-data obligations do not prove data completeness or real-world service delivery.

sources.title: Find and use bus open data
sources.facts: Explains access to timetable, fares and live location information from BODS.
sources.guard: Published data may be incomplete, delayed or unsuitable for exact service guarantees.

sources.title: Providing accessible information onboard local bus and coach services
sources.facts: Explains audible and visible information duties under the 2023 regulations.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove every vehicle or operator complies.
